description: Apply one regular expression to a text blob on the server and return every match with its index and capture groups. Deterministic, so the same input always returns the same answer. Useful for log triage, field extraction and validation at scale. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
